title: fix(ui): saved Side chat comments cannot send without a second question
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: saved highlighted-text comments appear in Side chat but cannot be submitted unless the user types a second question.

## User Impact

Users can send a saved selection/comment on its own, or include a written question. Image-only questions and image retries keep their existing behavior. No configuration or migration is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing Side chat question resolver recognized typed text and image attachments but ignored selection comments. It now supplies a neutral question for selection-only input, so the Ask button and keyboard submission use the same existing attachment path. Selection limits, upload restrictions, and pending-read gates are unchanged. No new state or lifecycle machinery is added (production +3/-1 lines, English copy +1, tests +42/-14; documentation also corrects obsolete quote-prefill guidance).

Reported by @Patrick-Erichsen.

## Work sessions

- [Original discussion with @Patrick-Erichsen](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/~key/dashboard/a1ccc8f5-058f-47d3-a6b6-a7a4625ae9c2)
- [Discussion, implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/~key/dashboard/c77a4506-e2f0-4b42-9a01-d86d969e44a9)

## Evidence

- Production-bundle Chromium reproduction on base `6f212fb009904efe6e9686f4bb433a39048b3b82`: saving the selected-text comment leaves Ask disabled. The same flow passes with this repair, and the request contains the full selected passage and edited comment.
- 15/15 browser E2E scenarios passed across the two touched suites (`--maxWorkers=1`; 46.00 seconds wall time including the production build). Coverage includes selection limits and edits, retained/main composer isolation, comment persistence, image-only file picking with exact request bytes, text+image retry, and send shortcuts. The image-picker case already passes on base; it is regression coverage, not a claimed image bug fix.
- 26/26 existing companion owner tests passed (`--maxWorkers=1`; 21.62 seconds wall time). Two focused main-chat image preparation/isolation browser scenarios also passed (27.92 seconds including build). No additional image-submission defect has been reproduced; that part of the user report remains open for clarification.
- Targeted UI typecheck, scoped lint (one existing reactivity warning), i18n verification, controller guard, format, and `git diff --check` passed. The initial typecheck rejected borrowed dependencies; an independently owned physical installation passed.
- Independent Codex P0–P2 autoreview completed with no actionable findings.
- Browser proof uses the real Control UI with synthetic Gateway I/O; it is not live model or physical-device proof. [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40431495246) passed; the shared browser-E2E job took 264 seconds (whole-job time, not incremental per-file cost).

### Before and after

Independently captured through the real Control UI with synthetic Gateway I/O in the linked original discussion; attached after merge. Both states have one saved comment and an empty question box.

Before: Ask is disabled.

![Before: saved Side chat comment cannot be submitted](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9aef6f53-17d8-4724-b734-7aad85802321)

After: Ask is enabled and submits the full selected passage/comment.

![After: saved Side chat comment can be submitted](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/269fdca0-ace5-4f08-a30c-49fe747bba3e)
